## #4 — tg_jp — 2013-06-02
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/9538/post-79412>

hi, thank you trying this script.

this script is a Tag script, you have to install it into ~/Library/Application Support/Scripts/Tag folder. 

1. assign this tag script to root or folder object of polygon objects that you want to edit.
2. click "make editor object: make" button for creating editor object that contains all polygons in hierarchy. ( writeback target property will be set automatically. )
3. edit uv of this editor object that be created by script.
4. after finishing editing, click "wirteback UV: write" button to write new uv information to each object in hierarchy.

and check this movie, it's for japanese though.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W5yUUlqseO4

I hope this will help your project.  

regards.
